listing.name: Paycheck Planner: Budget
listing.subtitle: Organize your money by payday
listing.promotionalText: See exactly what each paycheck has to cover and what is left after bills. Link recurring bills to the right payday and check them off as you pay.
listing.description:
Paycheck Planner budgets the way you actually get paid: one paycheck at a time.

Add your income sources and bills, and every upcoming paycheck shows which bills it covers and how much is left once they're paid.

PLAN EVERY PAYCHECK
• See each upcoming paycheck with its bills and what's left
• Browse month by month with a chart of what's left after bills
• Check bills off as you pay them and track progress per paycheck

FITS YOUR PAY SCHEDULE
• Weekly, bi-weekly, semi-monthly (like the 15th and 30th), or monthly
• For twice-a-month pay, shift weekend paydays to the Friday before
• Track more than one income source

BILLS THAT LAND IN THE RIGHT PLACE
• Link a recurring bill to an income source so it's added automatically
• Choose whether it comes out of every paycheck or just one paycheck a month
• Add one-time expenses to a specific paycheck, and move them if plans change
• Bill amount different this month? Change it for just that paycheck

PAY IN ONE TAP
• Save a payment link with each bill and open it right from your paycheck
• Optionally mark a bill paid when you tap its link

YOUR DATA STAYS ON YOUR PHONE
• No account, no sign-up, no bank connection
• Nothing is collected or shared; everything is stored on your device

Light and dark mode, plus an option to show whole-dollar amounts.

Paycheck Planner is free to use. Pro is a one-time in-app purchase (no subscription) that adds more income sources, a full year of paychecks, reminders, set-asides and savings goals, per-paycheck changes, earlier history, and CSV export.
listing.releaseNotes:
What's new in 1.1:
• Set-asides: plan spending money or savings on each paycheck, right next to your bills.
• Payday reminders: get a heads-up before each paycheck with its bills and what's left. You pick the day and time.
• Paycheck bigger or smaller than usual? Change the amount for just that paycheck.
• Short on a paycheck? Move a bill to another payday in a couple of taps.
• Now in 45 languages, with your local currency and date formats.
• Polish: haptic feedback, paid bills crossed off, this month marked on the chart, and the last month on the chart is no longer cut short.

review.notes:
1. SCREEN RECORDING
Attached to our reply in App Store Connect: recorded on a physical iPhone running the latest iOS, starting at launch and showing setup, the paycheck plan, bills and the Pro purchase. The app has no accounts, sign-in or user-generated content.

2. PURPOSE AND AUDIENCE
Paycheck Planner is a personal budgeting app for people who budget one paycheck at a time, for example anyone paid weekly, every two weeks or twice a month who needs to know which bills each paycheck has to cover. The user enters their pay schedule and recurring bills, and the app shows every upcoming paycheck with the bills due from it and the money left over. It answers "can this paycheck cover these bills, and what's left?" without connecting a bank account.

3. SETUP AND MAIN FEATURES
No login, account or sample files are needed.
- Fastest way: on first launch, tap "Try with sample data" on the empty Paychecks tab to load an example budget.
- Or set it up by hand: Income tab > add an income source (amount, schedule, next payday), then Expenses tab > add a bill and link it to that income. Upcoming paychecks appear on the Paychecks tab.
- Tap a paycheck to see its bills, check them off as paid, change an amount for that paycheck only, or move a bill to another payday.
- Settings (gear icon): reminders, display options, backup/export and erase all data.
Pro (one-time, non-consumable in-app purchase com.johnhaup.paycheckplanner.pro, no subscription): tap any control with a PRO badge, or Settings > Pro, to open the paywall, which shows the price, Buy and Restore Purchases. Pro adds more income sources, a full year of paychecks, reminders, set-asides and savings goals, per-paycheck changes, earlier history and CSV export. The free tier stays fully usable.

4. EXTERNAL SERVICES
- Apple StoreKit / In-App Purchase, for the Pro unlock only.
- Apple local notifications (scheduled on the device), for optional payday and bill reminders.
That's all. There's no backend server, no account or authentication service, no analytics, no ads, no AI service and no bank or financial data provider. All data stays on the device. The app makes no network requests of its own, apart from opening a bill's payment link in the browser when the user taps one.

5. REGIONAL DIFFERENCES
The app works the same in every region. It's localized into 45 languages and uses the device's locale for currency and date formats. The Pro price comes from the App Store for each storefront. No features or content differ by region.

6. REGULATED INDUSTRY / THIRD-PARTY MATERIAL
Not applicable. Paycheck Planner is a personal planning tool, like a spreadsheet: it doesn't move money, connect to banks, lend money or give financial advice, and it includes no protected third-party material.
